2. liver function and albumin/globulin: albumin 35.1 g/L (ref 35-52), globulin 30.8 g/L RAISED (ref 15-30), A/G ratio 1.14 LOW (ref 1.2-2.4)
3. whole-blood manganese: ELEVATED; fell after the supplements were stopped but remained above normal
4. brain MRI: bilateral T1 HYPERINTENSITY in the basal ganglia - manganese deposition
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Manganese-induced parkinsonism (manganism) secondary to chronic manganese supplementation and impaired biliary excretion due to liver cirrhosis.
